tasks.title: Restore and professionalize the Lite prompt system
tasks.outcome: The prompt system returns to a small two-role architecture: Interviewer reduces one decision-changing uncertainty at a time, while Sensemaker maintains evidence-linked decision memory, produces calibrated insight, generates three distinct lives and supports bounded reflection. Runtime readiness is deterministic and no longer depends on a 72-cell persona profile.
done_when: The health audit maps owner intent, product promises, prompt specifications, runtime calls and tests, and resolves every critical contradiction it finds.
Production flow has only Interviewer and Sensemaker model roles; PersonaAuditor, StopDecision and Planner are not called and the 72-cell matrix is not a generation or stopping gate.

Adaptive interviewing follows a progressive, autonomy-preserving sequence from concrete experience to contrast and optional future projection, with burden-aware question counts and no profile-completion questions.

Sensemaker wave, final and bounded-chat prompts separate evidence, provisional interpretation, imagination and unknowns; final routes are structurally different and every prototype tests one real uncertainty.
Odyssey play expands through optional grounded simulation lenses without adding another Agent or inflating the base FinalPlan contract.
Typecheck and representative integration tests prove deterministic stopping, prompt fallbacks, citation validity, route equality and bounded-chat behavior.
boundaries: Keep the product small: no user-visible or runtime-completion persona matrix, no personality scoring and no hidden profile questionnaire.
Use host code for caps, focus selection, readiness, validation, persistence and safety gates; use models only for semantic judgment and language generation.
Do not add an Agent when an existing Sensemaker mode or deterministic function can carry the responsibility.
Treat psychological interviewing principles as conversation design, not therapy, diagnosis or covert persuasion.
Preserve three equal futures and reversible experiments; playful simulations must label imagined details and remain grounded in user evidence.

completed: Reconstructed owner intent and the original two-Agent product promise.
Confirmed architecture drift: 72-cell persona gate, PersonaAuditor, StopDecision and Planner contradict completed task boundaries.
Identified unsafe fallback behavior that marks nearly all persona cells usable after Wave 2.
progress.current: Designing the first-principles target loop and prompt architecture.
progress.next: Rewrite the health brief and operational prompts, then reconcile runtime orchestration.
